newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares steady on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares steady on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were steady on Monday on lower turnover.
A shares were unchanged from Thursday's $114 and B were also unchanged at $117.875.
Turnover fell to 8,729 shares from 11,260 on Thursday and value was $1,010,197.63 from $1,291,466.
There was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic, none of which were traded in the last three weeks.
The LISPI stock index was unchanged at 84.60 and the BLOM stock index was also unchanged at 985.27.
